capabilities: Sync the vault two-way with a Google Drive folder on desktop and mobile
Pick up files placed in the folder by other apps, scripts, or teammates
Merge or keep side by side conflicting edits instead of losing them
Stop and ask before applying large deletions
Sign in with the user's own Google OAuth client or an rclone token
extras: README warns to back up the vault first since two-way sync can overwrite or delete files on either side; detailed setup and privacy docs are in separate TECHNICAL.md and PRIVACY.md; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Google Drive two-way sync, and other sync plugins only see files they created themselves, missing notes added by other apps or people.

requires.name: Own Google Cloud OAuth client (client ID and secret)

summary: Two-way Google Drive sync that sees every file in the synced folder, merges or keeps conflicting edits, and confirms large deletions.
